name: Nikkei
h1: One operating layer for news, data and AI products
lede: Nikkei is launching enterprise AI products and expanding its index business alongside its core news operation. Airtable gives editorial, product and commercial teams one shared way to run launches.
why_h2: New products across AI and indices
why_p: Recent launches add new programmes to track across editorial, product and commercial teams, each with its own deadlines and partners.

signals.title: NIKKEI KAI MCP launched
signals.body: Nikkei launched NIKKEI KAI MCP, an enterprise AI offering.
signals.angle: Enterprise data products need a shared operating layer across editorial, product and commercial teams.

signals.title: Nikkei 225 constituent changes
signals.body: Capcom, Kokusai Electric and JX Advanced Metals join the Nikkei 225 from 1 October 2026 while three names leave.
signals.angle: Index operations run on deadlines and approvals that suit a connected workflow, not inboxes.

signals.title: New entertainment and content index
signals.body: Nikkei began calculating a 20-company entertainment and content index on 18 June 2026.
signals.angle: Keep launches, partners and content for each new product line in one view.
